name: subtitle-learning-extension
description: A Chrome extension for extracting, analyzing, and learning from video subtitles

scripts.test:language-preferences: tsc tests/language-preferences.test.ts src/utils/language-preferences.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --outDir /tmp/language-extension-language-preference-tests --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node --test /tmp/language-extension-language-preference-tests/tests/language-preferences.test.js
scripts.test:subtitle-processor: tsc tests/subtitle-processor.test.ts src/utils/subtitle-processor.ts src/types/subtitle.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --outDir /tmp/language-extension-subtitle-processor-tests --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && NODE_PATH=./node_modules node --test /tmp/language-extension-subtitle-processor-tests/tests/subtitle-processor.test.js
scripts.test:subtitle-timing: tsc tests/subtitle-timing.test.ts src/utils/subtitle-timing.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --outDir /tmp/language-extension-subtitle-timing-tests --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node --test /tmp/language-extension-subtitle-timing-tests/tests/subtitle-timing.test.js
scripts.test:youtube-timedtext: tsc tests/youtube-timedtext.test.ts src/utils/youtube-timedtext.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --outDir /tmp/language-extension-youtube-timedtext-tests --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node --test /tmp/language-extension-youtube-timedtext-tests/tests/youtube-timedtext.test.js
scripts.test:timed-words: tsc tests/timed-words.test.ts src/utils/timed-words.ts src/types/subtitle.ts --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --outDir /tmp/language-extension-timed-words-tests --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node --test /tmp/language-extension-timed-words-tests/tests/timed-words.test.js
